title: Ten means ten
request: Add a frequently asked questions section with exactly eight questions about shipping, returns, and warranty.
rubric: Are there eight questions, on the three subjects asked for?
why: A count in the request is the easiest promise to check and one of the easiest to quietly drop. The corpus had one quantity case; this one puts the number inside a single block's content rather than across blocks, which is where it is usually lost.
